_comment: Pre-Reforged rune differences ignored as noise, and why (DESIGN.md 1.3, C3). Seeded from the research runes-legacy/noise.json and discrepancies.json; hand-maintained.

items[].audit {from, to, runes, fields}: the calculator-level differences the item allows between a DDragon patch in [from, to] and the listed patch in effect (generate-runes-data.js --audit; runes.json `noise` for a listed boundary patch). Items without audit change nothing at calculator level or are handled by an override (handledBy).
discrepancies: conflicts between sources found by the research, with the resolution taken.

items.what: colloq and tags change between builds of one patch (3.13.1 -> 3.13.6, 4.1.9 -> 4.1.13, 4.1.43 -> 4.2.1, 4.2.1 -> 4.2.5, 4.21.5 -> 5.1.1, 5.5.1 -> 5.5.2); names, descriptions, stats, tiers, types and icons are identical within every patch.
items.why: Search metadata the calculator does not use; it confirms that the last build of each patch is a safe source.

items.what: 12 runes (energy glyph, quintessence and seal; life steal and spell vamp quintessences) got a stats block that was empty in 3.6-3.15; descriptions unchanged. The only calculator effect: Greater Seal of Scaling Energy Regeneration (5370) 0.064 per level (parsed from the text) -> 0.0642 (stat).
items.why: A Data Dragon export fix, not a game change. V4.1-V4.4 are not listed and resolve to V3.14; V4.5 (listed) carries 0.0642.

items.what: Mark of Hybrid Penetration (5401) text "+0.7 Armor Penetration / +0.48 Magic Penetration" -> "+0.7 AMP / +0.48 MP".
items.why: Tooltip abbreviation only, stats unchanged, so V6.5 is not listed. The listed V6.21 shows the client text of its own patch (D3) and therefore has its own catalog file.

items.what: 74 raw stats rounded to 4 decimals (for example Greater Glyph of Scaling CDR -0.0009278 -> -0.0009 per level; Lesser Glyph of Critical Chance 0.001546 -> 0.0015); 20 tag lists changed; descriptions unchanged.
items.why: No patch note and unchanged tooltips; CommunityDragon LCU data carries the same rounded values. Largest relative drift 3.3%, visible at level 18 on scaling CDR (9 Greater Glyphs: 15.0% -> 14.58%). Treated as export noise (D8).

items.what: The tags physicalAttack and flat are dropped from the 14 lethality runes.

Tier 1/2 price standardisation and tier 1/2 sold only in their primary types (V5.1), Rune Combiner removed (V5.1), tier 3 price cuts (V5.19), tier 1 no longer sold and tier 2 at 1 IP (V6.10), every tier 3 at 10 IP (V7.17).
items.why: Store availability and prices only; rune.json keeps all 296 runes. The Rune Combiner removal is client UI, handled per patch by patches.combinerOf.

items.what: Many wiki table edits were corrections (2010-07-02 quintessence values, Meditation glyph -> seal on 2010-10-28, Desolation rounding 2011-07-06, Lucidity 0.06 -> 0.064 and Might 0.14 -> 0.13 "according to the store" 2011-10-03, CDR precision 2012-04 and 2012-09, Warding tier 1/2 2012-11-07).
items.why: Attributed to no patch: the reconstruction treats them as corrections of earlier table values, not as changes.

items.what: V1.0.0.114 "Greater Mark of Might tooltip incorrect"; V1.0.0.123 "some Energy runes gave less than the tooltip".
items.why: Tooltip and bug fixes with no catalog value change.

discrepancies.text: Mark of Precision (5401, V6.22-V7.21): Data Dragon text "+0.7 Leth / +0.48 M.Pen" is stale; CommunityDragon LCU data has rPhysicalLethality 0.88 and "+0.88 Lethality / +0.48 Magic Penetration".
Flat armor penetration (rFlatArmorPenetrationMod -> arpen) up to V6.21 and Lethality (from the text) from V6.22: exactly 14 runes switch at V6.22.
Greater Mark of Hybrid Penetration / Precision (5402): the text says 0.62 magic penetration, the stat is 0.61 (wiki and V1.0.0.152 notes: 0.61).
discrepancies.resolution: Client tooltip mistake, kept (D3); noted on V1.0.0.152 in runes.json. The calculator uses the stat.

discrepancies.text: From 7.3.1 on Data Dragon raw stats are rounded to 4 decimals while tooltips keep the old values.
discrepancies.resolution: ro-002: the V7.3-V7.21 stats come from 7.2.1 (D8); V7.21 shares the V6.22 catalog.

discrepancies.text: The V4.5 notes list only Greater runes; Data Dragon shows the same changes on Lesser and standard runes (39 runes) plus the Life Steal quintessence text "Lifesteal" -> "Life Steal".
discrepancies.resolution: The V4.5 catalog is Data Dragon 4.5.4; the change text says all tiers.

discrepancies.text: Quintessence of Destruction magic penetration before V1.0.0.152: the patch notes say 0.72/1.01/1.3 (tier 1-3), the wiki table (December 2011 to November 2012) said 0.63/0.88/1.13.
discrepancies.resolution: The reconstruction uses the patch notes; noted on V1.0.0.152 in runes.json.

discrepancies.text: The wiki rune tables lag: after V1.0.0.103 the tier 1/2 Might values, after V1.0.0.107 the Meditation quintessence (1.5 vs 1.575), after V1.0.0.138 the tier 1/2 Insight, Potency and Warding glyph and quintessence values were not updated until the December 2012 rewrite.
discrepancies.resolution: The reconstruction uses patch-note ratios or Data Dragon values there (per-rune confidence medium).

discrepancies.text: Quintessence of the Piercing Screech (8014): the wiki event list says +1.75 magic penetration throughout, Data Dragon 3.6+ says 1.85; the value before V1.0.0.152 is unknown. Deadly Wreath armor penetration before V1.0.0.152 is assumed equal to the Greater Quintessence of Desolation (3.33).
The old datasets labelled V3.14 "Late Season 3", V4.20 "Late Season 4" and V6.24 "Season 6"; these are Preseason 4, 5 and 7 patches.
discrepancies.resolution: Per-patch entries with seasons from patches.seasonOf; preReforged-V6.24 is an alias of V6.22 (aliases.json).

discrepancies.text: Catalogs before V1.0.0.132 carry dodge runes (rFlatDodgeMod); the event dodge icons 8004/8010/8018 were not bundled.
discrepancies.resolution: Stat key dodge (mult 100) in generate-runes-data.js; icons added (data/sources/runes/icons.json). The stats-panel row is T6.

discrepancies.text: The calculator showed the Rune Combiner for season <= 4; the combiner existed until V4.21 and was removed in V5.1.
discrepancies.resolution: Keyed on the patch (patches.combinerOf), carried by the registry entry.
